grammar_focus: can / be able to 的用法(KS19)主考——can → be able to(能力互换)、将来用 will be able to(can 无将来式)、过去用 was/were able to;was able to 表'(具体一次)成功做到了',此时不能用 could;run into trouble、order sb to do、a great many + 复数、get over / by 表相差(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 1929年,美国探险家 R.E. 伯德在飞越北极3年之后,第一次飞越了南极。虽然起初伯德和助手们拍下了飞机下面连绵群山的大量照片,但他们很快就陷入了困境。在有个地方,飞机似乎肯定要坠毁了——只有飞到一万英尺的高度,它才能飞过这些山头。伯德马上命令助手们把两个沉重的食物袋扔掉,于是飞机得以升高,在离山头400英尺的高度飞越了过去。伯德这时知道他能够顺利飞抵300英里以外的南极了,因为前面再没有山了。飞机毫无困难地飞过了这片茫茫无际的白色原野。

grammar_card.title: can 与 be able to:表'能够'
grammar_card.intro: can 和 be able to 都表'能够'。can 没有将来式,要说将来的'能'得用 will be able to;过去用 was/were able to。关键:表示'(某一次)成功做成了'时,必须用 was able to,不能用 could。全用本课句子举例。

rows: He is able to swim. = He can swim.
I'll be able to see you tomorrow.
They were able to take photographs.
某次成功做成(不用 could)
The plane was able to rise and cleared the mountains.
He said he would be able to see me next week.

specialRules.rule: 表示'(某一次)终于成功做成'时,只能用 was/were able to,不能用 could:The plane was able to rise(飞机成功升高了)。
specialRules.mark: 成功做成用 was able to

specialRules.rule: can 没有将来式,说将来的'能'用 will be able to;转述里用 would be able to。
specialRules.mark: 将来用 will be able to

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How was the plane able to clear the mountains?
options: By throwing out two heavy food sacks so it could rise higher

passage: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole, the American explorer, R.E. Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time. Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below, they soon ran into serious trouble. At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash. It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet. Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks. The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet. Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away, for there were no more mountains in sight. The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.

grammar_points.name: can = be able to(现在能力)
will be able to(将来能力,can 无将来式)
was / were able to(过去能力)
was able to 表'成功做成'(不用 could)
run into trouble(遇到麻烦·辅考)
order sb to do(命令某人做·辅考)
a great many + 复数(大量·辅考)
get over / by 表相差(辅考)
